customProducts.name: Yupek Logo | Small Chest Print, White Cotton Shirt
customProducts.material: 100% premium quality fabric tailored for modern living.
customProducts.description:
Soft, breathable cotton with a clean, minimalist chest sketch — this tee feels quietly confident. The light crew neck and classic relaxed cut drape easily over mornings spent sketching, late-night record digging, or riverbank hangs with friends. Small printed details on the sleeve and inner neck add a subtle, insider touch that rewards anyone who notices. It wears like a well-loved staple: simple, honest, and ready to be part of everyday rhythms.

Product features
- 100% cotton (solid colors) — medium-weight 180 g/m² for year-round comfort
- Tubular knit (no side seams) and ribbed collar for shape retention
- Dual printing: DTF for sleeve/inner neck and DTG for main prints — crisp detail
- Tear-away label and shoulder tape for comfort and durability
- OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certified; ethically sourced US cotton

Care instructions
- Non-chlorine: bleach as needed
- Do not iron
- Do not dryclean
- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F)
- Tumble dry: low heat

customProducts.name: Yupek Logo Ornate Patch crewneck sweatshirt | Boho Medallion Back Print
customProducts.material: 100% premium quality fabric tailored for modern living.
customProducts.description:
Soft, slightly oversized, and quietly detailed — this crewneck brings heritage-inspired embroidery into everyday wear. The embroidered chest patch and matching back emblem read like a woven memory: warm rusts and earthy motifs that sit gently against a clean ivory canvas. It feels like slipping into a favorite library chair after a long walk: relaxed shoulders, a soft midweight heft, and a collar that keeps its shape. Wear it with faded denim, layered under a coat, or draped over a linen dress. The stitched accents give a subtle, artisanal touch that stands out without shouting, and the tear-away neck label keeps the inside as comfortable as the outside.

Product features
- Embroidered accents at chest, back, and optional wrist placements
- Midweight 50/50 cotton-poly blend (8.0 oz/yd²) for warmth and durability
- Tubular knit (no side seams) for cleaner drape and reduced waste
- Ribbed knit collar and double-needle stitching for long-lasting shape
- DTF inner neck labels; OEKO-TEX® certified dyes and ethically grown US cotton

Care instructions
- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F)
- Non-chlorine: bleach as needed
- Tumble dry: low heat
- Do not dryclean
- Do not iron
